interview_identity.role: Speaker of the IBM Group Works Council specialist committee for personnel data systems
interview_identity.interview_context: BTQ Kassel follow-up to a 10 March 2022 online event

extraction_method: Fetched the BTQ Kassel page with curl and converted the rendered HTML to plain text with pandoc for manual review of the question-and-answer sections.
reported_implementation_signals: AI systems were reported in use in internal call centers and for recommendations about training and career paths.
A global system recommending salary increases for managers was reported as not used in Germany at the time of the interview.
A system estimating the probability of voluntary resignation was also reported as not used in Germany.
The interview states that the framework controls introduction for German employees, while it cannot necessarily stop global development teams from creating systems.
evidence_boundary: The interview is a representative account of reported practice and scope, not an independently audited deployment inventory, model audit, worker survey, or outcome evaluation.
